My dear [Miss Smith](/person/263),
I have at length obtained the account for the [Biographies](/book/43) and am glad to be able to send you the enclosed as your share of the proceeds. Your account of the Procession was in time, and is going in this month with an Illumination story of the last time London was in a blaze.
After this week please to add Elderfield before Otterbourn [sic] in our address. It is a cottage in the village we are going to move to, as [my brother](/person/1624)’s family are beginning to outgrow our house

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
